evidence.quote: Secondo Mona evolved into a leading player in the global aerospace industry with a strong focus on fuel systems and equipment for aircraft and helicopter, thus maintaining solid routes in its territory of origin and employing today around 350 people. || The company is still located on the same site acquired by the founder in 1918 in Somma Lombardo on an area of 28,000 square metres || Our products are developed according to customer specifications and in close collaboration with airframer, engine and main systems OEMs at a global level.
